text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the spring Tenno Sho. We'll need to best Special Week if we're to seize victory here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe has been racing well for a while, but the more intense her emotions get, the greater the stress her body has to endure. Her passion is eating away at her like a poison.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Should I even be encouraging her to chase after her friend? Bound by the contract we made, I can only pray for her good health.
